flagged.title: Waterloo 1815 and Balaclava 1854: leadership, technology and reporting
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly states that Russian artillery at Balaclava was rifled and breech-loading (F17), which is historically false and mark-affecting for GCSE questions evaluating technological change.

mark_affecting.quote: the Russian field artillery was now rifled and breech-loading.

flagged.title: London’s response: government, Royals, propaganda and ‘Dig for Victory’
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims Winston Churchill chaired 115 Cabinet meetings in the Cabinet War Rooms 'during the Blitz alone', misattributing the total figure for the entire war (1939–1945) to the Blitz.

mark_affecting.quote: 115. That is the exact number of War Cabinet meetings that Prime Minister Winston Churchill chaired underground in those very rooms during the Blitz alone.
